parties: Kamlesh Jain (acquirer); Jain Resource Recycling Limited (target)
headline: Kamlesh Jain files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Jain Resource Recycling Limited
sum: Kamlesh Jain has submitted a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE following a substantial acquisition of shares in Jain Resource Recycling Limited, triggering SEBI Takeover Code filing obligations.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures signal entry into the 25% threshold band; partners must track whether this triggers a mandatory open offer under Regulation 37 and confirm whether exempt categories (family/succession) apply.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person acquires shares that cross specified thresholds (typically 25%). The filing by Kamlesh Jain indicates a substantial shareholding event in Jain Resource Recycling Limited. The specific acquisition value, number of shares, and resulting shareholding percentage are contained in the filed disclosure document. Regulation 31(4) is a gating provision that determines whether further obligations (such as mandatory open offer under Regulation 37) arise.
